name: emotion-sphere-animation-engine
description: fork branch from Frank's Emotion Sphere Animation

paragraphs: An interactive particle sphere that visualizes emotion. A field of soft glowing circles ("fireflies") blooms, breathes, ripples, and disperses to express four emotions — calm, sad, warm, anger — each as a looping, animated preset.
Built for the IPMD Emotion Sphere project — a digital art installation intended to help children explore and reflect their emotional state. Project Manager: Myranoush Khan.

Design reference: Figma — Emotion Sphere Particle Engine redesign — the panel UI in index.html follows this for layout/visual direction; not every screen is built yet, and implementation may diverge in small ways.
features: User guide — UI controls, every parameter, easing curves
Preset format reference — the .txt grammar, for hand-editing or generating presets
Gemini integration — wiring up "Describe a feeling"
